title: Rizia/Turn 10/NATIONAL DESTABILIZATION
description:
NATIONAL DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES

STAY AND FIGHT OR ABDICATE

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around at my advisors. Lik..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around at my advisors. Like me, they hadn't been getting much sleep over the past week.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And asking Wehlen to come to our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And asking Wehlen to come to our aid a second time is obviously out of the question."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite great efforts from Cardess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Cardesse-Montaklar and your home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite great efforts from Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Brenas and your home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite great efforts from your ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from your home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite great efforts from Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Brenas and Cardesse-Montaklar, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Despite great efforts from Cardess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Cardesse-Montaklar, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo shook his head regretfully."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo shook his head regretfully.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am sorry. I promise you, Hubertu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. I promise you, Hubertus tried his best."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: He gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I knew the Sazons could not be cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew the Sazons could not be counted on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He unrolled a map on the table. It..."
entries.dialogueText: He unrolled a map on the table. It was covered in bright red markings.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head regretfully."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head regretfully.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I am sorry. My house tried its bes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. My house tried its best to contain the unrest."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It is my unfortunate duty to repor..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my unfortunate duty to report that the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Soldiers have been deserting the P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers have been deserting the Pales front en masse. I fear they are joining the anti-monarchist cause as well."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Soldiers have been deserting our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers have been deserting our army bases en masse. I fear they are joining the anti-monarchist cause as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's voice was hoarse when she..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's voice was hoarse when she finally spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: She swallowed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite great efforts from both of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from both of our home provinces, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite great efforts from Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Brenas and your home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite great efforts from your ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from your home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite great efforts from Brenas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from Brenas and my home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Despite great efforts from my home..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite great efforts from my home province, the revolutionary movement rages stronger than ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked pointedly at Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: She looked pointedly at Hugo.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am sorry. I promise you, Hubertu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. I promise you, Hubertus tried his best."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gritted her teeth."
entries.dialogueText: She gritted her teeth.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I knew the Sazons could not be cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew the Sazons could not be counted on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head apologetically."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head apologetically.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am sorry. I did try my best to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. I did try my best to marshall House Azaro, but..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""After we failed to reach an accord..."
entries.dialogueText: "After we failed to reach an accord on your reforms, revolutionary activity reached a fever pitch."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She unrolled a map on the table. It..."
entries.dialogueText: She unrolled a map on the table. It was covered in bright red markings.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Soldiers have been deserting the P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers have been deserting the Pales front en masse. I fear they are joining the anti-monarchist cause as well."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Soldiers have been deserting our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers have been deserting our army bases en masse. I fear they are joining the anti-monarchist cause as well."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's happening again. Another upri..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's happening again. Another uprising."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena looked close to tears."
entries.dialogueText: Elena looked close to tears.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The riots have brought our industr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The riots have brought our industries to a standstill. The economy will not survive this."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It appears that our long-awaited r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It appears that our long-awaited reunification with Pales is in serious jeopardy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not to mention our international s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention our international standing, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our Intermerkopum partners have ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Intermerkopum partners have expressed serious worries about the future of our alliance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Our partners in GRACE are refusing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our partners in GRACE are refusing to trade with us until stability is restored."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Now that we are no longer with GRA..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that we are no longer with GRACE, it's hard to imagine any other allies siding with the monarchy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And asking Wehlen to come to our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And asking Wehlen to come to our aid yet again would be devastating to our global image, to say the least."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be so dramatic. Everything's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so dramatic. Everything's going to be fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people have made themselves cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people have made themselves clear. The Crown shall spare no expense in meeting their demands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God save us all.""
entries.dialogueText: "God save us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So be it. I was getting tired of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So be it. I was getting tired of this job anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In other words, Rizia is screwed...."
entries.dialogueText: "In other words, Rizia is screwed. Is that it?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I-- I don't think that's an accura..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I don't think that's an accurate prediction, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""An accurate prediction, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "An accurate prediction, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Don't underestimate the severity o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't underestimate the severity of the situation, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Even if that could solve the probl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if that could solve the problem, we don't have the expenses to spare."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's too late even for miracles, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late even for miracles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't have lost all support amon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't have lost all support among my subjects. Why can't I marshall my remaining loyalists against these interlopers?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have never been certain that fig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have never been certain that fighting the first uprising was the right decision. I wonder whether it is worth fighting the second."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I have my own doubts, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have my own doubts, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What alternatives do I have, then?""
entries.dialogueText: "What alternatives do I have, then?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall order two hundred crates o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall order two hundred crates of Cantuavo, ten dozen live lobsters and the finest caviar I can get my hands on. If the monarchy is to go down, we shall go down in luxury."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The kingdom's tensions with Sordla..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kingdom's tensions with Sordland are at an all-time high. The government is reluctant to devote resources to Rizia at this particular point in time."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The kingdom is on the verge of a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kingdom is on the verge of a peaceful resolution with Sordland. They are reluctant to engage in any action that could be seen as aggressive or interventionist."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The kingdom is currently under hea..."
entries.dialogueText: "The kingdom is currently under heavy scrutiny by the international community. So the government is reluctant to engage in any action that could be seen as aggressive or interventionist."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And frankly, I don't see why any o..."
entries.dialogueText: "And frankly, I don't see why any of the revolutionaries would listen to nobles like us. We've let the people down for the last time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle had a lost look in his eye..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle had a lost look in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I remember the promise you made on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember the promise you made on your mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But in the end, Your Majesty, I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in the end, Your Majesty, I am only one man."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked down at her stomach and..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked down at her stomach and frowned.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I won't pretend everyone feels..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I won't pretend everyone feels the same way."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You can try. But with the military..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can try. But with the military beginning to turn against us, amassing a sufficient number of skilled fighters won't be easy."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You can try. But with the military..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can try. But with the military beginning to turn against us, amassing a sufficient number of skilled fighters won't be easy."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Especially with certain nobles and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially with certain nobles and their armies out of the picture."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Especially after our actions again..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially after our actions against certain members of the nobility."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To the extent that our finicky lit..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the extent that our finicky little heir allows me to."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You can try. But with the military..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can try. But with the military beginning to turn against us, amassing a sufficient number of skilled fighters won't be easy."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That doesn't rule out Queen Beatri..."
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't rule out Queen Beatrice providing aid in the future... but by then, it may be too late."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Especially with certain nobles and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially with certain nobles and their armies out of the picture."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I would fight for you until the en..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would fight for you until the end, of course..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I would fight for you until the en..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would fight for you until the end, of course, but as you can see, that's not worth much anymore."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I myself am sworn to protect my Ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself am sworn to protect my King until the end, and I intend to do so along with the rest of my guardsmen."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Wruhec's Guardians maintain their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec's Guardians maintain their loyalty to you, Your Majesty. And the larger Wruhecist community is grateful for everything you've done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured down at his wheelchair."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured down at his wheelchair.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Rizia's Wruhecists continue to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's Wruhecists continue to be grateful for everything you've done for them, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""You lost the loyalty of Rizia's Wr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You lost the loyalty of Rizia's Wruhecists a long time ago, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But Dastnurists and Golcondists ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Dastnurists and Golcondists are massing against you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But Dastnurists are massing agains..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Dastnurists are massing against you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But Golcondists are massing agains..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Golcondists are massing against you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Dastnurists and Golcondists as wel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dastnurists and Golcondists as well."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Dastnurists as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Dastnurists as well."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Including Golcondists.""
entries.dialogueText: "Including Golcondists."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose since Rizia is already s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose since Rizia is already secular, they see no difference between us and the Malenyevists."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Until the Malenyevists tear down t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until the Malenyevists tear down their sanctuaries."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I remember our conversation on you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember our conversation on your mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At the time, I thought there was n..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the time, I thought there was no worse fate for Rizia than a king who defies the laws of God and nature."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I see now that there is someth..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I see now that there is something more dreadful still. A Rizia with no king at all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I once thought the worst fate that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I once thought the worst fate that could befall Rizia was a king with no regard for royal tradition."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I cannot make this decision for yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot make this decision for you. But I will remind you of one thing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I once thought the worst fate that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I once thought the worst fate that could befall Rizia was a monarchy stripped of power."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The movement has turned on him sin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The movement has turned on him since his reform plans failed, Father. He hasn't dared to set foot in the House of Delegates for weeks now."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The movement has turned on him, Fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The movement has turned on him, Father. He hasn't dared to set foot in the House of Delegates for weeks now."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have seen kingdoms fall all aro..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have seen kingdoms fall all around us. We can try to stem the tide of history, losing God knows how many lives in the process..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You say that as if democracy were..."
entries.dialogueText: "You say that as if democracy were the inevitable consequence of progress. Today's 'people's governments' will fall apart in time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia must die for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia must die for the Republic of Rizia to be born."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Maybe so. But the people must find..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe so. But the people must find that out for themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is this how you've secretly felt a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this how you've secretly felt all along, traitor? That the monarchy should have crumbled long ago?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Or we can accept our fate and hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or we can accept our fate and hope for peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're of noble stock yourself, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're of noble stock yourself, Mr. Esquibel. Do you really think the revolutionaries won't murder us both?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If we give them what they want, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we give them what they want, they'll have no reason to do so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Either way, our golden age is over.""
entries.dialogueText: "Either way, our golden age is over."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Heavens, no! The fact that it has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heavens, no! The fact that it has lasted to this day speaks to the strength and wisdom of our monarchs -- yourself included, of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Or not. I could be wrong. We could..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or not. I could be wrong. We could have another century or more left in us."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Kingdom, but not necessarily t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom, but not necessarily the King."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Aunt Bea, looking out for herself..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aunt Bea, looking out for herself first. I'm hardly surprised."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of silent acknowledgement pa..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of silent acknowledgement passed around the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of stunned shock passed arou..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of stunned shock passed around the table.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that is how you wish events to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is how you wish events to unfold... So be it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My councilors exchanged solemn look..."
entries.dialogueText: My councilors exchanged solemn looks of acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So be it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So be it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The age of kings and queens shall..."
entries.dialogueText: "The age of kings and queens shall come to an end."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So be it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head fiercely."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head fiercely.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm not leaving you. And I'm capab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not leaving you. And I'm capable enough of fighting for two."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God be with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "May God be with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""So be it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""So be it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita, you're carrying our child..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita, you're carrying our child and  the possible heir to the throne. You should stay out of harm's way as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is only going to be a tempora..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is only going to be a temporary measure. We'll all reunite someday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you all for your service. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you all for your service. It has truly been a pleasure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish you all a happy retirement.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you all a happy retirement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish there was another way. I ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish there was another way. I hope you'll all forgive me."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Rizia will become a godless nation if the Malenyevists win. Don't they realize that?"

entries.dialogueText: "I don't blame them. God means nothing if you can't put food on your table."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Do not judge them too harshly. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not judge them too harshly. They only seek to better their families' lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.dialogueText: "They feel they have no other alternative."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know what I swore.""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Until my dignified retirement.""

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am asking nothing of you, Romus...."
entries.dialogueText: "I am asking nothing of you, Romus. But I know what I would do in your stead."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""One of the few luxuries that isn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of the few luxuries that isn't afforded to a monarch, I'm afraid."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then you know what you must do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you know what you must do."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena sadly, silently shook her hea..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: He unrolled a map on the table. It was covered in bright red markings.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The events of several weeks ago, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "The events of several weeks ago, while effective at neutralizing certain internal threats to the Crown, threw Rizia's security apparatus into disarray."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""And given the strength of the revo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And given the strength of the revolutionary movement, the resulting upheaval could not have come at a worse time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you questioning my decision to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you questioning my decision to defend myself from my enemies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me something I don't know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me something I don't know."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""So you're aware of the worsening s..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're aware of the worsening situation."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""No, Your Majesty. Just pointing ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Just pointing out that the guilty parties were not the Crown's only enemies."

entries.dialogueText: "I and my men may not have had a hand in directly dealing with the unrest, but we have been watching the situation closely."

entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""After the Houses failed to reach a..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the Houses failed to reach an accord on your reforms, revolutionary activity reached a fever pitch."

entries.dialogueText: "Since you deployed the Golden Guard against the unrest, my cohorts have found themselves increasingly outnumbered."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Thank you, sir. But unfortunately,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, sir. But unfortunately, both of our tenures are in jeopardy."

entries.dialogueText: "No need to state your case. You're my new security councilor now."

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty...

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Romus... Your Majesty...

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "And I regret to say we have radio silence from the team sent to rescue Princess Vina."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "More than I'd like to, I'm afraid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're my bodyguard. What do you k..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're my bodyguard. What do you know about the revolutionary movement?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Unfortunately, I believe the revol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, I believe the revolutionary movement is now out of our control."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Since you deployed Wruhec's Guardi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since you deployed Wruhec's Guardians against the unrest, Sevrio and his cohorts have found themselves increasingly outnumbered."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Soldiers have been deserting our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers have been deserting our army bases en masse. I believe they are joining the anti-monarchist cause as well."

entries.dialogueText: "While the events of the Queen Mother's birthday were effective in neutralizing certain internal threats to the Crown, the upheaval among the houses only fueled the revolutionary movement's fire."

entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stepped over from his post by..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stepped over from his post by the door.

entries.dialogueText: "I will get a message out to Adarfo Sotelato. I am prepared to abdicate the throne and yield to the revolution."
